kindIds.description: kindId = keccak256("ard-onchain.kind.<name>"). Reserved names are listed but not defined.

termIds.description: Identifiers of the base vocabulary and the reserved names. Dimension ids are keccak256('sai.dimension.<d>'); term ids keccak256('sai.<d>.<name>'); roles keccak256('sai.role.<name>'); origins keccak256('sai.origin.<name>'); resource kinds keccak256('sai.resource.<name>'); decision-point questions keccak256('sai.dp.<name>'); effects keccak256('sai.enact') / keccak256('sai.refuse') / keccak256('sai.status-quo').

identifiers.note: profileId / interestId / denominationId / descriptorKind = keccak256(UTF-8(identifier)); methodId = keccak256(UTF-8(JCS(descriptor))); relationId = keccak256(UTF-8(JCS(relation))) for identity relations (Section 3.4)
